name: Ulysses Wilhelm
source:
If we do not learn from our history, we are doomed to repeat it; Ulysses knows this lesson well, as the Ultimate Historian. Spending every waking moment reading and researching the histories of human civilizations, to the point of exhaustion, Ulysses is determined to memorize as much as he can, even at the cost of his own health and sanity. Known for carrying around a notebook, he makes sure that every interaction he has is always recorded for future review.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1352764192613429253]official description[/url]]
